method: Repository snapshot audit based on the five existing index files. Re-run tools/catalogue/audit_catalogue.py after index changes.
coverageNote: These are index records, not unique physical objects and not the complete contents of external catalogues. The NASA index contains 29 planetary STL records cross-listed in Height Maps; count source files separately from collection placements. Catalogue-page references and archive packages are not individual mesh files.
limitations: Cross-source physical-object matching is not complete; IDs are unique record IDs, not canonical object IDs.
The 256 asteroid records point to source detail pages and are not direct mesh files.
Archive package records represent ZIP/7Z bundles, not the number of meshes inside them.
The 3D Asteroid Catalogue reports 1,635 asteroids, 5 comets, 2 dwarf planets, 37 moons and 3,079 models; SPACEMESHER has not yet imported that full source inventory.
